sources.title: Ilya Sutskever – We're moving from the age of scaling to the age of research
sources.quote_checked: These models somehow just generalize dramatically worse than people. | Now, from 2020 to 2025, it was the age of scaling | So it's back to the age of research again, just with big computers. | We got to the point where we are in a world where there are more companies than ideas by quite a bit. | I now place more importance on AI being deployed incrementally and in advance. | I think it would be really materially helpful if the power of the most powerful superintelligence was somehow capped

sources.title: AI with reasoning power will be less predictable, Ilya Sutskever says
sources.quote_checked: But pre-training as we know it will unquestionably end | While compute is growing, the data is not growing, because we have but one internet. | The more it reasons, the more unpredictable it becomes

sources.title: Safe Superintelligence Inc. Launches With Backing From Ilya Sutskever
sources.quote_checked: Our singular focus means no distraction by management overhead or product cycles. | By safe, we mean safe like nuclear safety as opposed to safe as in 'trust and safety'
